anchor_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: rough hand-drawn character reference anchor for a Korean sermon slide deck. Input images: Image 1 is a visual style reference only; do not copy its subject, text, or content. Primary request: Create one very small fictional Gospel Traveler character in the style of a rough diary slide: deliberately uneven black pen contour, naive hand-drawn doodle, simple flat fills, slightly imperfect proportions, minimal facial marks, lots of pure white page around the figure. Subject: a tiny gender-neutral side-profile figure with short black bowl-cut hair, one dot eye, a tiny nose and mouth, a simple orange tunic, a small deep-teal shoulder bag, white socks, brown shoes, holding one blank scroll. Style/medium: rough black ink line, visibly jittery line weight, slight contour gaps, imperfect hand control, flat gray/coral/teal fills, no gradients, no glossy rendering, no soft cinematic light, no polished children’s-book illustration, no vector clip-art. Composition/framing: centered, full body, very small, 8–18% of a landscape slide when reused, huge empty white space. Lighting/mood: quiet, observational, slightly awkward and human. Color palette: black ink, orange-red tunic, slate gray accent, deep teal bag, cream paper. Text: none. Constraints: preserve the exact tiny silhouette, black hair, orange tunic, teal bag, simple side-profile face, and rough pen style in every later scene; no glasses, no cape, no detailed costume, no halo, no cross, no historical person, no Jesus, no Paul, no text, no watermark. Avoid: polished illustration, 3D, anime, detailed shading, realistic anatomy, decorative background. Aspect ratio: square.
